headline: Directs congressional leaders to arrange a single Congressional Gold Medal honoring Filipino veterans of World War II, to be housed at the Smithsonian.
what_it_does: The law defines who counts as a Filipino veteran of World War II for this honor, including people who served honorably from July 26, 1941, to December 31, 1946, under U.S. Armed Forces in the Far East in listed Philippine or U.S.-led units. It directs the President pro tempore of the Senate and the Speaker of the House to make arrangements for one Congressional Gold Medal to be awarded to these veterans. After the award, the medal goes to the Smithsonian Institution for research and display, and Congress states its view that the Smithsonian should also display it at other places linked to these veterans.
when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 14, 2016; the summary does not give a separate effective date for the medal award.
